Family coverage: this is a plan, no scope path is fixed or covered yet; every scope path below is uncovered and must be covered by a test that fails without its fix before the code candidate's adversary PASS. An agency re-confirms a fresher observation with no drift; its ACTIVE authorization target_contract_hash is immutable (0015 commercial_authorizations_immutable), so CMD036 answers TARGET_STALE (execute-project.ts:125), admission cancels the QUEUED job (authority.ts:48), nothing resumes it. R2 asks to pause affected execution with included repair/refund/new-scope paths without an automatic extra charge. REVALIDATE_INCLUDED has no command in any lane, REQUEST_REFUND is deferred, and the no-charge assertion is vacuous (no charge path exists). A capture concluding after supersession meets TARGET_STALE (subject.ts:54) or KP004 (0015:604-610); no cell for the paid capture outcome.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Only an execution whose approved values the newer contract lost is paused; unaffected entitlements stay executable or are re-bound at no charge by a named tested command. Each affected entitlement keeps its cents and has an executable included path, or the case is PARTIAL with the missing path named to a package. A capture concluding after supersession ends in a stated state with amounts asserted.

findings.title: X2 TaxDocument mapping is unsound: it inverts R2 15:137, maps the open CORRECTION_REQUIRED state to terminal CORRECTED, and lets PROVIDER_PENDING reach ISSUED without DIAN acceptance
findings.reproduction: R2 15:137 'Provider-specific states map explicitly to this model' means provider states map into the R2 TaxDocument model; the plan uses it to make the registry machine govern instead. CORRECTION_REQUIRED (a document that still needs correction) and VOIDED_BY_VALID_CORRECTION both map to CORRECTED; in state_transitions.json CORRECTED is terminal, reached only by corrected_draft_version from REJECTED or lawful_credit_or_correction_issued from ISSUED, so an open fiscal obligation reads as resolved. PROVIDER_PENDING maps to UNCERTAIN and UNCERTAIN goes to ISSUED on issued_document_found, so a provider-held document without DIAN acceptance can become ISSUED, against 15:139 'A provider PDF existing does not prove DIAN acceptance'.
findings.acceptance_criterion: A recorded decision maps each R2 state to a registry state or (state, evidence) pair without merging states of different obligation; CORRECTION_REQUIRED is non-terminal; ISSUED requires observed fiscal acceptance, not only the provider identity; a T6 table test asserts each row.
findings.failing_test: T6 'X2: a provider-found document whose fiscal acceptance is pending stays UNCERTAIN (not ISSUED); a correction-required rejection is not terminal'.

scope.why: TaxDocument machine: CORRECTED terminal; ISSUED guard

findings.title: The importer-profile gate reason IMPORTER_PROFILE_* is discarded: the consumer maps CONTRACT_FAILURE to ERROR with no reason, so a deterministic plan defect is classed as a validator error

findings.title: X1 rewrite and the M1 race leave outcomes underspecified: T0:262 must keep state and version unchanged; the loser-opens-a-reconciliation outcome holds only when the winner finalizes
findings.reproduction: If the winner receipt leaves the stage NEEDS_CORRECTION, the loser differing bytes are a valid next submission (revision 2, not a reconciliation); if the winner leads to RECEIPT_VALIDATING the loser is STAGE_NOT_AWAITING (X5). Rewriting T0:262 to 200 drops its implicit guard that the resubmission is not a correction unless it asserts state NEEDS_CORRECTION and version unchanged (rule 14).
findings.acceptance_criterion: The RACE cell names the winner outcome for each order (finalizing, NEEDS_CORRECTION, RECEIPT_VALIDATING); the rewritten T0:262 asserts receipts 1, state NEEDS_CORRECTION and version unchanged.
findings.failing_test: T1 'R2-025: RACE ... NEEDS_CORRECTION winner: the loser appends revision 2'.

findings.title: L2 catalogue keyed by profile names while target_contracts.importer_profile_id is a uuid; the gate must verify the run.target digest equals subject.targetContractHash before judging
findings.reproduction: 0003:240 importer_profile_id uuid NOT NULL, with no mapping to HUBSPOT_IMPORT_UI etc. receipts.ts:200 recomputes the plan body digest, but the plan adds ValidationRun.target without a matching digest check.
findings.acceptance_criterion: A stated tested mapping from (importerProfileId, importerVersion) to a catalogue entry (unknown is refused), and a TARGET digest mismatch is refused before the gate.
findings.failing_test: T2g 'DENY an unknown importer profile id' and 'DENY a target body whose digest is not the intent targetContractHash'.
